name: fabric-connection-manager
description: Fabric admin connection API showcase with asynchronous notebook collection and a snapshot-backed dashboard.
author: Microsoft

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
